source_standard: Blameless retrospective format (SRE lineage, applied to non-incident retros), https://www.blameless.com/blog/retrospective-template

reference_resolution.rule: action_items must each resolve to an actual tracked issue — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: action_items is recomputed from timeline evidence, never pre-filled; blame language directed at a person is refused at write time (blameless constraint).
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a non-incident issue closes AND no issue-retrospective record exists yet for that issue
